about: Rows a person wrote, each with its source, for what no dump can prove: an operator moved to C++, guidance for a removal with no rename, or a recorded raise. A row's hint is the sentence Blender's error gains (bpy_angelo_renamed_api.cc), refusal the replacement the pre-run refusal names (script_api_removed.py), note the line a script's result carries (script_api_notes.py). Curated rows are certain: the refusal and the note may use them. replay_cleared lists generated rows (use, owner, property, name) that a replay of recorded scripts cleared for the refusal and the note.

rows.name: NISHITA
rows.hint: Blender 5.0 renamed 'NISHITA' to 'SINGLE_SCATTERING' (the same model: files saved with 'NISHITA' open with it); the new default is 'MULTIPLE_SCATTERING'
rows.refusal: use 'SINGLE_SCATTERING' (Blender 5.0 renamed 'NISHITA' to it, the same model: files saved with 'NISHITA' open with it); the new default is 'MULTIPLE_SCATTERING'
rows.note: Blender 5.3 has no sky_type 'NISHITA': use 'SINGLE_SCATTERING' (the same model: files saved with 'NISHITA' open with it); the new default is 'MULTIPLE_SCATTERING'.
rows.source: Recorded agent scripts, October 2026 benchmark runs (qa/MISTAKE-CATALOGUE.md class 6: 240 of 1,094 distinct Angelo scripts); Blender 5.0 Python API release notes
